changelog:
Initial release: Presents any one paper-reading workspace in a React/Vite app, showing modules, summaries, and source-linked previews.

- Generates a read-only local Workspace Presentation from exactly one source workspace or source chain.
- Produces structured module summaries with direct links to original source files; lists and previews source artifacts.
- Scaffolds or refreshes a presentation app at `{workspace-root}/presentations/{presentation-slug}/`, preserving existing app code by default.
- Always passes a confirmation “Presentation Source Gate” if the source or output would be ambiguous.
- Outputs required presentation metadata and summaries, following strict citation and display rules.
- Clearly instructs the user to install and run the app, and only does so automatically with explicit user permission.
summary: Create a React/Vite Workspace Presentation from one paper-reading source workspace or source chain. Use when the user wants to package, present, review, hand...
